"Is it found in space?" singles out the rocket, leaving airplane and helicopter together. "Is it bigger than a car?" would not split them well, since all three are probably bigger. "Does it have wheels?" is also an option: airplanes have wheels, helicopters mostly have skids, and rockets have none. That is ambiguous, so space is the cleaner choice.
